prerequisites: Node.js 16 and npm. CI tests on Node 16.
Docker, to run PostgreSQL with PostGIS and RabbitMQ.

steps.title: Start PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ
steps.text: These containers use the CI images. They are for local use only: PostgreSQL accepts connections without a password, and RabbitMQ accepts its default `guest` user from your machine. Use the `rabbitmq:3` image: RabbitMQ 4.1 and later refuse connections from the AMQP client in this repo (`frame_max` 4096 is below the new minimum).

steps.title: Set the connection URLs
steps.text: The migrations, the tests, the seed, and the server read these variables. Set them again in each new terminal.

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.text: At this commit, 5 of the 45 integration tests fail with `no partition of relation "domain_event_handled" found for row`: the migrations add date partitions only up to the end of 2023. Because of that, `npm test` stops before the repository tests. Run them with `npm run test-repository`.

steps.title: Add sample data (optional)
steps.text: The seed first deletes all trees, captures, and grower accounts. Then it adds about 19,000 sample captures, 3,300 trees, and 54 grower accounts.

steps.title: Start the server
steps.text: The API listens on http://localhost:3006 (for example, `/trees`). The Swagger UI is at http://localhost:3006/api-docs/.
